name: AI Answer Guard
description: Reduce AI hallucination risks, evidence-based self-contradictions, and false “task completed” claims before your assistant answers or acts. AI Answer Guard is a free, local, read-only MCP server that checks supplied sources for duplicate or conflicting evidence, compares success claims with tool execution results, flags missing permissions and irreversible-action risks, and suggests concrete corrections—while connecting 313 published derivative entries to Nakagawa Master’s canonical original theories. Calls are host-chosen; no automatic interception.
